name: Takiko
source:
She doesn't care much for humans and is really not into the idea of marrying one. Takiko may seem like she is in a bad mood most of the time, but they say she's actually pretty lonely. 

from [url=/https://kavorkaplay.com/post/190518096089/hanapon-princess]Kavorka[/url]
